settings.name: Mark
settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A beautifully detailed hotel and residential development model, complete with LED-lit rooms, swimming pools, landscaped grounds and amenities, all to scale. The centrepiece every sales gallery needs to sell a property before it is built.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your development design, scale, branding and lighting
settings.s1_body: A great property model does more than show a building - it sells a lifestyle. This hotel and residential model brings a development to life with warm LED-lit rooms, glittering pools, landscaped gardens and amenity areas, all reproduced to scale from your drawings. Buyers see themselves in it instantly. The ideal centrepiece for a sales gallery, launch event or developer's reception.
settings.case_heading: The Heart of the Experience Center
settings.case_body: Commissioned for SG Serenity Hotel in Morocco, this lit hotel model became the centrepiece of their Experience Center - buyers gathered around it, picturing themselves in the rooms and by the pool, and the sales team used it to close every viewing.
settings.case_quote: Visitors fall in love with it. The lighting and pools sell the lifestyle better than any brochure.
settings.prov_p: It's easy to believe that property scale models are just for developers. But even hospitality brands and hotels can use a scale model of their property to differentiate their service from competitors, leading to more conversions and a stronger impression on every visitor.
